description: This file defines the PdfLayoutAttributes class, which represents a PDF layout attributes object within the PdfSharp library. It includes constructors to initialize the object both with and without a document, sets an owner element, and defines a nested Keys class containing constants for PDF layout attribute keys such as BBox.

classes.name: PdfLayoutAttributes
classes.description: Represents a PDF layout attributes object, inheriting from PdfAttributesBase, and manages layout attribute keys and initialization.

classes.name: Keys
classes.description: Contains predefined keys for PDF layout attributes, including the 'BBox' rectangle attribute.

methods.name: PdfLayoutAttributes(PdfDocument document)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the layout attributes object with an owning PDF document.

methods.name: PdfLayoutAttributes()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the layout attributes object without a specified document.

methods.name: SetOwner()
methods.description: Sets the owner element of the attributes, specifically assigning the 'O' element to the string '/Layout'.
